content: Typer current stable is 0.27.2 (Python >=3.10), now under the fastapi org. Since 0.26 Typer vendors Click (8.5.0) internally. Typer builds CLIs from type hints, adds Rich help, shell completion; Click is the lower-level engine. For a multi-command CLI (run/resume/status/runs/artifacts/events) Typer is the standard 2025/2026 choice; argparse only if zero-dependency is required.
